_about: P10 (playtest: a new player faced 50 pieces at once and didn't know where to start): pieces you learn by building. A piece in 'after' can be built once you have built the piece it names at least once in this game (taking it down again doesn't forget it); the build menu shows it locked with that piece's picture. Pieces not listed here are open from the start, unless a Hub milestone or a project locks them (the milestone pieces need the Hub, which needs a workbench). Test worlds know every piece; a real new game starts knowing only the open ones (main.gd), and a save from before P10 knows everything.
